profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc.
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Engineer with experience in several languages including Angular, Java, C#, tcl, and perl.  Experience with Database Administration and SQL development for Oracle,  MS SQL, and MySQL.  Application support for a variety of software packages both home grown and 3rd party  in a global environment. 

I am interested in a challenging position with a high level of responsibility where my wide range of skills can be leveraged to drive success.  I love fixing things, whether it be systems, processes, working relationships or whatever other challenges you face.

Specialties: Solution design, development, integration, deployment, and support.  KT Problem Solving.  Building effective teams.  Process modeling.  Documentation.  Project Management.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description:
Sr. Developer and Solution Architect in the Mobile Apps group.  Responsible for the architectures, templates and processes for mobile application development at Micron. 

- Mobile application development using the Ionic framework targeting iOS and Android platforms
- Citrix XenMobile MAM and MDM
- PushSharp implementation for push notifications
- Product owner for development environment and applications
- Oversee development by overseas team in an Agile environment

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Sales & Marketing
positions.description:
Design and development of Sales and Marketing's customer facing web sites as well as internal tools and processes.  

- Implemented an effective Knowledge Management solution with a focus on process and metrics.
- Train,mentor, and oversee work of an off-shore team
- Requirements gathering and system design for new and existing software solutions
- EDI mapping with Gentran and B2B integration with Cyclone
- .Net development of web based tools supporting the sales and marketing departments. 
- Architect for migrations of public facing websites from home grown systems to SiteCore and IBM Websphere Commerce platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Engineering
positions.description:
Responsible for the global Synchronicity design data management implementation.

- Unix system administration
- Perl, TCL, and shell scripting
- Integrating revision control, data mirroring, into the design environment.

positions.title: President
positions.description: Streamliner Aquatics is a non profit club supporting a year round competitive swim team and swim lesson program.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for all software systems in the company
- Supported/Consulted high-end Sun/Windows/Linux dedicated hosting customers
- N-tier system design and implementation
- Project management
- Administrator for MSSQL, Sybase, and Oracle Databases 
- Part of a 24-hour on-call rotation in a data center environment 
- Developed tools for departments within the company using Java, PHP, Perl and shell scripts 
- Supported legacy code and processes
- Implemented and maintained billing and provisioning systems/processes
 - Created accounting reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop/supported the Sun Managed Hosting product line 
- Supported/Consulted customers by phone and email 
- Worked with n-tier system design and implementation 
- Installed/supported application servers, databases and web servers
 - Was included in 24 hour on-call rotation in data center environment
 - System administration of Windows, Linux, and Solaris 
- Developed tools for departments within the company using 
Java and shell scripts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained code for legacy authentication and accounting systems
- Designed and developed web-based programs using Java, Servlets, JSP, Perl, HTML, and Sybase
